card.name: Cause-of-death wording before attribution
card.fires_on: Words in statements about deaths just before the cause is named or attributed, such as "death", "unknown", "as", "due" and "cause". It fires where the next word is likely "cause", "due to" or "attributed".

modes.label: Death plus unknown cause
modes.description: The word "unknown" after "deaths of" or "died of", right before cause or etiology.

modes.label: Adjudicated or presumed cause
modes.description: Linking words in phrases saying a death was judged to be due to a cause.

modes.label: Death in a case report
modes.description: The word "death" or "cause" in a report of one person's death, before the cause is stated.
modes.example: declaring Nong Sam's<< death>> a suicide.

card.writes: It boosts words that assign a cause, such as attributed, caused and attributable.
card.plain: It marks spots in death reports where the cause is about to be stated or attributed.
